prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: SaaS服务合同新旧条款对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "条款号" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 2: header "原文" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1563px
  col 3: header "修订后" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 3232px
  col 4: header "修订说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 1425px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照SaaS服务合同的新旧条款及修订说明，帮助读者识别每项合同义务的变化。","reading":"读者先按条款号定位，再横向比较原文与修订后文本，最后阅读修订说明；同一行应作为一个比较单元。","groups":["原文与修订后承担相同的合同正文角色，需要并列比较；修订后内容更长，可适当获得更多宽度。","修订说明与两版正文共同解释同一条款的变化，但属于辅助说明。","条款号是行标识，应保持紧凑并便于纵向扫描。"],"keep_intact":["条款号，如第12.4条","合同中的数字、期限及其他不宜拆开的标识"],"may_wrap":["原文和修订后的中文合同正文可自然换行","修订说明可自然换行；正文较长的行通常可以吸收说明列的换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [83, 190, 285, 161] · table 720×1404px · row heights [36, 246, 246, 292, 315, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [83, 200, 285, 151] · table 720×1428px · row heights [36, 246, 269, 292, 315, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [78, 190, 300, 151] · table 720×1381px · row heights [36, 246, 269, 269, 292, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 12 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"条款号完整且易于纵向定位；原文、修订后与说明形成清晰的横向比较单元。说明列较宽，第5.3条的说明与修订正文收尾接近。","problems":"第7.2条和第9.1条的修订正文较密、行数较多，原文下方留下较大空白；第12.4条说明也比正文短不少。","cause":"修订后列为285px，长条款需要较多换行；各列内容长度不一，行高由最长单元格决定。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"条款号完整，200px的原文列略宽，正文与修订后仍可并排比较。","problems":"说明列显得狭窄，第5.3条的说明比修订正文更长，拉高整行；第12.4条说明也接近行底，阅读节奏较局促。原文列增加的宽度没有明显改善整体行高。","cause":"从说明列转出10px给原文列，使说明列降至151px，而修订后列仍为285px。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"300px的修订后列改善了长条款的换行，第7.2条和第9.1条更从容；整体行高也有所降低。","problems":"第12.4条的条款号断成两行，破坏行标识的纵向扫描；说明列仍较窄，第5.3条和第12.4条的说明接近或达到各自行底。","cause":"条款号列仅78px，扣除内边距和边框后不足以容纳完整标识；说明列为151px，长说明换行较多。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"修复条款号","widths":[83,185,300,151],"change":"以r2C为基础，将条款号列恢复至83px，确保第12.4条完整；从原文列让出5px，保留修订后列的阅读空间。"},{"name":"均衡说明列","widths":[83,185,290,161],"change":"在完整条款号的前提下，将修订后列的10px转给说明列，尝试减少第5.3条和第12.4条说明的换行，同时仍比r2A多给修订正文5px。"},{"name":"修订正文优先","widths":[83,175,300,161],"change":"压缩较短的原文列，同时保留300px修订后列及161px说明列，检验能否让较长的正文和说明更均衡地占用行高。"}]}
